cues: Third normal form: remove transitive dependencies.
The faculty head depends on faculty, not directly on the student, so it gets its own faculty table.
Now Science's head is stored once.
Four tables, every fact in one place, and joining them on their keys gives back every original row exactly: the decomposition is lossless.
